content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves a collision over the Isaiah 7:14 link between the defender's chain (8:8, 9:6-7) and the challenger's pressed bounds and seed rows, which is the weighing K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the sign itself does not state the mechanism","rule_words":"the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires","room":"'the pressing side's own chain read together': either the Isaiah 8 witnesses count as the defender's chain, so the rule applies fully, or they count as loose verses, so it applies less.
